# Capacity and headroom
Use this after setup without guest login. Compare CPU mean/P95/maximum with memory and disk evidence, then inspect hourly trends. Thresholds are triage heuristics, not sizing recommendations. CPU alone cannot size a server or SQL instance; review concurrency, latency, I/O, working set and business cycles separately.

One row per exact resource ID/metric/volume. Parent, guest and standalone are operator-declared topology, not discovered hardware capacity. Unclassified stays explicit. Never sum parent and guest CPU/memory/disk or infer physical capacity from this view. SQL host counters are not SQL engine capacity evidence.

Missing values remain blank, never zero. Coverage counts observed one-minute bins over the entire elapsed window (including parking); it is not uptime or agent availability. Freshness >15m, <24h history and <80% coverage warn explicitly. Disk Delta is last minus first free-space percentage points, not a forecast; `_Total (aggregate)` is not per-volume evidence. Queries use existing Perf/InsightsMetrics only; no new collection or retention.

content.title: Hourly evidence (separate units and volumes; absent hours stay absent)
